# onepassword_server (Resource)

Manage 1Password server items.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Item title.
- `vault` (String) 1Password vault title.

### Optional

- `admin_console` (Block, Optional) Admin console credentials. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--admin_console))
- `hosting_provider` (Block, Optional) Hosting provider details. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--hosting_provider))
- `note` (String) Item note.
- `notes` (String) Item notes (deprecated in favor of note).
- `password` (Block, Optional) Server password recipe. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--password))
- `sections` (Attributes) Item sections map. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sections))
- `tags` (List of String) Item tags.
- `url` (String) Server URL.
- `username` (String) Server username.
- `version` (Number) Version trigger to refresh ephemeral values.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Item ID.
